notification_delivery_supersede_uniq.name: notification_delivery_supersede_uniq
notification_delivery_supersede_uniq.where:
dedupe_key is not null and channel = 'in_app'
            and status in ('pending','sent','delivered','seen')

notification_delivery_idempotency_uniq.name: notification_delivery_idempotency_uniq
notification_delivery_idempotency_uniq.where: dedupe_key is not null and channel <> 'in_app' and status <> 'failed'

workflow_intent_kind_dedupe_active_idx.name: workflow_intent_kind_dedupe_active_idx
workflow_intent_kind_dedupe_active_idx.where: dedupe_key is not null and status in ('pending', 'processing')
